Class BridgeTck

java.lang.Object
io.micronaut.sourcegen.bytecode.tck.AbstractByteCodeWriterTck
io.micronaut.sourcegen.bytecode.tck.BridgeTck
public abstract class BridgeTck extends AbstractByteCodeWriterTck
Bridge methods: which bridges a generated class needs, their flags and descriptors, and the dispatch through them, compared with the bridges javac writes.

A backend runs these tests by extending this class and implementing AbstractByteCodeWriterTck.write(io.micronaut.sourcegen.model.ObjectDef).

Since:
2.3
